description: Rung 10 (finale) of DETERMINEX_LIVE_REACT_UNIFIED_PRODUCT_SHELL_SERIES. Asserts all six prior dimensions are closed (Tauri command surface, unified navigation panel, Repo Clinic panel, Maintenance Bay panel, Learning Studio panel, user-level / teaching mode) AND none of them opens source_mutation_authorized or training_eligible AND none of them opens unsupported-claim keys (all_apps_claim, all_languages_claim, all_codebases_claim, no_followup_claim, production_ready_arbitrary_apps_claim, training_enabled_in_demo, readiness_treated_as_authorization). Evaluator at scripts/repair/live_react_unified_product_shell_final_state.evaluate is read-only on disk; never runs a runtime gate. release_ready stays False (public release scrub/install/demo workflow is a future rung). First-splash implementation (DETERMINEX_IDEA_LAB_PYTHON_CLI_VERIFIED_SPLASH_DEMO_LOCK_001) is the recommended next rung. AMENDED 2026-07-20: originally nine dimensions. Idea Lab panel, Proof/Operator Center panel, and splash demo panel dropped -- their panels + locks + tests were deliberately deleted in commit 30b3ff570 ('chore: land pending IDE product shell archive'), which determined ~74 ide-product-shell panels including these were a Claude<->Codex tandem-pipeline trail, not real durable features. This finale kept requiring their now-deleted lock files, which was a stale check pointing at intentionally-removed work, not a real certification gap. Re-creating those panels to satisfy the old requirement would reintroduce exactly what that archival correctly removed.
